remediations.problem: orchestrator retries a non-idempotent sink - duplicate-write risk

actions.description: Make the sink write idempotent (merge/upsert with deterministic keys, or staging write + atomic swap)
actions.rationale: retries are safe only when replays converge
actions.validation: force a retry in staging; diff the output

actions.description: If the sink cannot be idempotent, cap retries at 0-1 for the writing task and alert on failure
actions.rationale: bounded retry contains the blast radius
actions.validation: task retries config + failure alert fires

risks: retry=0 trades duplicates for manual recovery

actions.description: Schedule compaction (rewrite_data_files / OPTIMIZE) matched to ingest rate
actions.rationale: small files accumulate proportional to commit frequency
actions.validation: file-count trend flat over a week

risks: compaction during peak ingest can contend
validation_steps: run compaction during a peak window once, measure impact

remediations.problem: stream sink retries with side effects - replay risk

actions.description: Key sink writes by (source offset, batch id) or enforce dedup on the sink
actions.rationale: replay of the same batch is the failure mode
